scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n shared,api,worker,web -c gray,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @notebook-lite/shared" "npm run dev -w @notebook-lite/api" "npm run dev -w @notebook-lite/worker" "npm run dev -w @notebook-lite/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
